nodes.description: Understand the absolute value of a rational number as its distance from 0 on the number line; interpret absolute value as magnitude for a positive or negative quantity in a real-world situation. nodes.description: Understand p + q as the number located a distance |q| from p, in the positive or negative direction depending on whether q is positive or negative.
